name: Coated In Darkness shortens Blood Pact when Bloodbolt is cast (#2324)
contract: Coated In Darkness 704625 reads 'Casting Bloodbolt or Bloodfang Bite now reduces the cooldown of your Blood Pact by $/1000;804205S1 sec'. Its single effect is aura 42 (proc trigger spell) on Coated in Darkness 804205, one SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN with BasePoints -501 (-500 ms) and MiscValue 801955 (Blood Pact). Spell.dbc gives 704625 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped it and Blood Pact's cooldown never moved. Blood Pact 801955 has RecoveryTime 120000. The cut is only 500 ms, less than a cooldown can decay on its own while the scenario runs, so a control pair of adjacent steps first proves that an idle step pair decays the cooldown by less than 400 ms; only then is a 400 ms drop across the Bloodbolt cast attributable to the proc. Bloodbolt is cast as rank 578305 (the rank a level-80 character owns; 578304 is only granted up to level 52 and gets no server response), SpellFamilyFlags (0, 131072, 0).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Coated In Darkness passive is active
SETUP: Blood Pact is on its 120 sec cooldown
CONTROL: cooldown before an idle step pair
CONTROL: adjacent steps decay the cooldown by less than 400 ms
DISCRIMINATING: Bloodbolt cuts Blood Pact's cooldown by at least 400 ms
